source_review: Engine flushes pending pack first and accepts skip only when no earlier stop exists and optional native hook returns literal True. No rejected claim gets after_question_failed; original error/null and work ID remain visible.

Native supports only original strict C06 authority and frozen subject context. Exact selected failed work, generation, full identity/source-binding refs, fingerprint, current original owner and subject binding are checked.

Original native _physical re-derives receipt, exact shared physical request, settled fee, source subject receipt and last attempt; target has no CP. Shared siblings must have exact original latest attempt and either failed/noCP or validated ready/delivered CP.

Same original scope unknown work blocks; active/unknown/foreign/new-generation and unbound work cannot be skipped. Original owner authority is rechecked at both boundaries and every future POST keeps its native guard.
No model-produced claim, new lease, lease extension, score default, body repair, new generation or retry of failed work is introduced.
